name: SolidWorks-style 3D section triad, multi-view quads, and workflow AI Engineer
summary: Slide and tilt multi-plane sections with a 3D reference triad and solid hatched caps, inspect in synchronized quad viewports, or run multi-step workflows straight from AI Engineer Chat.

highlights.title: 3D section triad & solid cap faces
highlights.text: Drag a SolidWorks-style 3D reference triad to slide and tilt up to three planes in Planar, Zonal, or Slab modes, with triangulated polygon cap faces, ISO cross-hatching, component exclusions, and outer ghosting.

highlights.title: Live section properties & cut snap
highlights.text: Compute real-time cut area, perimeter, hydraulic diameter Dh, centroid, and principal moments on every plane, snap Measure directly onto cut bores, or export a 1:1 2D SVG profile.

highlights.title: Synchronized multi-view layouts
highlights.text: Switch between Single, 2-View Split, 4-View Quad, and Section Quad viewports with lockable orthographic panes, persistent active sectioning while measuring, and labeled multi-view captures.

highlights.title: Actionable AI Engineer workflows
highlights.text: Propose and approve multi-step cross-section, multi-view, isolation, measurement, and HTML report workflows in AI Engineer Chat or locally with zero API key, complete with one-click view restore.

highlights.title: Preview older SolidWorks & Parasolid
highlights.text: Open saved-display previews for supported older SolidWorks assemblies and read pointer-list text Parasolid models (viewing preview, not exact B-rep geometry) with unit limits shown.

notes: Local native SolidWorks (.SLDPRT/.SLDASM, including 3400/4100/4700/6000/15000 profiles) and Siemens NX (.prt) geometry viewing uses the separate Windows Native Kit (Setup-Pro3DWorks-Native.cmd) and a separately installed NVIDIA usd-convert-cad 0.3.0 runtime under NVIDIA's licence terms.

Legacy saved-display support in the single-file download applies to the exercised SolidWorks 2800 carrier profile and saved active configuration. All required companion files must be supplied and match intrinsic type, creation, configuration and save data.

Conversational cloud AI responses require your configured OpenAI-compatible or local LM Studio endpoint; deterministic Local workflows, section properties, and multi-view layouts run entirely in the browser.
